hypothesis: A dedicated release-stage skill can enforce localized static-page metadata and evidence without weakening exact-pair translation or source-drift boundaries.

evidence.source: Google Search Central: Localized versions of your pages
evidence.accepted: Use explicit alternate-language URLs, reciprocal links where equivalents exist, self-canonical pages, and an x-default route without inventing a missing equivalent.
Keep declared language signals distinct from rendered-body detection and record their reconciliation and reliability limits.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Add SEO and rendered-language checks to every exact-pair translation skill.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Would repeat web-delivery rules across language pairs and blur translation with publication validation.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Expand okhp3-i18n-page-sync to validate HTML release metadata.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Would weaken its intentionally narrow, deterministic source-drift contract.

limitations: No native-language quality benchmark was run.
No live browser or production-search validation was run.
The optional rendered-language adapter is not bundled.
